project_type: Kiro Crew - Python AI agent workspace (aiohttp gateway) with a bundled 'design-critique' built-in app; backend handlers are aiohttp web handlers, capture scripts are Node .mjs (Playwright).
language: Python 3.10-3.14 (default set to 3.11 via pyenv); Node 22 for the .mjs capture scripts.
build_system: setuptools (pip install -e '.[dev]'). Dev tooling pinned in pyproject.toml [dependency-groups].dev (pytest 9, pytest-asyncio 0.20.3, flake8, etc.). NOTE: none installable in this sandbox (see environment_constraints).
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio in STRICT mode (asyncio_mode=strict) - every async test needs @pytest.mark.asyncio. App tests live under src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/<app>/tests/ and see the rootdir conftest.py plus the app's own tests/conftest.py if present (design_critique has none). Existing suite: src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/design_critique/tests/test_backend_routes.py uses monkeypatch and a minimal _Req stand-in exposing .json(); it patches routes._run, routes._node, routes._uploads_dir, routes.socket.getaddrinfo.
build_command: pip install -e '.[dev]'  (FAILS in this sandbox - PyPI blocked. Use AST/py_compile + node --check for host validation instead.)
test_command: python -m pytest src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/design_critique/tests/test_backend_routes.py  (CANNOT RUN here: aiohttp and the kiro_crew package are not importable offline. See environment_constraints for the feasible validation path.)
verification_instructions: Because the full dependency set is not installable offline, verify with: (1) `python -m py_compile <changed .py files>` for Python syntax; (2) `ruff check <changed files>` (ruff 0.16.1 is preinstalled) - note ruff runs with DEFAULT rules, not the repo flake8 config, and the file already has 6 pre-existing default-rule findings, so only NEW findings introduced by the change matter; (3) for any .mjs change, `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check <file>`; (4) a self-contained pure-Python unit check of the new reuse/staleness helpers that stubs out sys.modules['aiohttp'] and the kiro_crew sub-imports BEFORE importing routes, OR extracts the pure logic so it can be exercised without aiohttp. Also add real pytest tests in the existing test module (they will run in CI even though they cannot run here) following the existing monkeypatch pattern.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None relevant. No snapshot/generated-file regeneration is involved in this change.
setup_instructions: pyenv global is set to 3.11.15. Intended setup is `pip install -e '.[dev]'` from repo root, but it fails here (403 from PyPI under INTEGRATIONS_ONLY). Node scripts run with `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node ...` because the ambient NODE_OPTIONS points at a missing preload bootstrap.
environment_constraints: NETWORK = INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: no PyPI/npm/registry/outbound HTTP. `pip install` returns 403; no offline wheels for aiohttp/pytest-asyncio exist in caches. Therefore the kiro_crew package and aiohttp are NOT importable, so `python -m pytest` on this module CANNOT run in-sandbox. Host validation is limited to: python -m py_compile / AST parse, ruff check (default rules), and `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check` for .mjs. The ambient NODE_OPTIONS='--require /opt/amazon/kiro-agent/proxy-bootstrap.js' points at a missing file, so prefix node invocations with `env -u NODE_OPTIONS`. Do NOT attempt to install packages. Real pytest tests must still be authored (CI runs them) but their pass/fail cannot be confirmed here; validate their SYNTAX with py_compile.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: commit types feat/fix/refactor/docs/test/chore/ci/build/revert. Lint gate (not runnable here): check_black_formatting.py, isort, flake8, mypy, then pytest. Only black-format files you touch (`black --target-version py310 <files>`) - do not bulk-format. Tests must not touch the operator's real machine; use tmp_path and monkeypatch routes._uploads_dir like the existing tests do. Keep changes scoped to the design_critique app.
key_patterns: Module-level state guarded by a threading.Lock is the established pattern: _JOBS/_JOBS_LOCK with _sweep_jobs/_get_job/_start_job. Transient upload dirs are swept by _sweep_clones (TTL _CLONE_TTL_SEC=3600) which removes dc-clones/* and dc-probe-* but DELIBERATELY skips dc-render-* (referenced by saved critique history). The probe runs in _discover_from_dir: creates probe_out=<uploads>/dc-probe-<uuid12>, runs capture-build.mjs <dir> --routes=<csv of first <=20 route paths> --out=<probe_out>, parses JSON manifest (probe['screens'] = [{route, path, chars, overlay}]), sets seeable[route]=True, THEN immediately shutil.rmtree(probe_out). The manifest 'path' is an absolute PNG path inside probe_out named build-<saferoute>-<ts>.png. handle = clone_id (12-hex) for repos, 'local:<path>' for local, 'url:<value>' for url. In _handle_render (repo/local) refs come from picks; it builds capture-build.mjs --routes=<csv of refs> --out=dc-render-<uuid12> --full, then _render_capture_job maps manifest screens by route to picks. Note discover probe runs WITHOUT --full; render runs WITH --full (full-page screenshot), a real difference the reuse contract must acknowledge.
directory_structure: src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/design_critique/ = { backend/routes.py (all handlers + helpers), skills/design-critique/scripts/*.mjs (capture-build, capture-site, discover-routes), tests/test_backend_routes.py + test_manifest.py, app.json, __init__.py }. .agents/tasks/ holds this plan.
